issues.explanation: For a police-related trauma profile, 'Blood' can be plausible, but paired with the rest of this profile it implies an injury/death-heavy trauma context that is not otherwise supported by the other selected threat items or strategies. The profile otherwise centers on danger scanning and aggressive arousal, so this specific trigger is somewhat mismatched and makes the trigger set less coherent.

issues.item: Maladaptive Strategies: Avoid Grief Reminders: Anything that reminds me of someone I have lost
issues.explanation: 'Avoid Grief Reminders: Anything that reminds me of someone I have lost' implies bereavement/loss as a central feature of the trauma response. That is hard to reconcile with the rest of the selected items, which focus on ongoing danger sensitivity and defensive behavior rather than traumatic loss, and there are no memory or appraisal items supporting a loss-based formulation. This is the clearest incoherent item in the profile.

issues.item: Avoid Grief Reminders: Anything that reminds me of someone I have lost
issues.explanation: This item is hard to reconcile with the rest of the profile. The trauma type is police-related, and the other selected items center on danger cues (blood, throwing objects, photos), hypervigilant threat processing, and safety behaviors. Avoiding reminders of 'someone I have lost' implies a bereavement/loss-focused formulation that is not supported by the trigger, threat, or other strategy items, nor by the stated trauma type. In this profile it stands out as a clinically incoherent maladaptive-strategy item rather than an unusual but plausible variation.
